messages:
mike_sales: Quick heads-up 80% chance we close MedSys EU POC if we return SIG/CAIQ + DSAR/deletion evidence by COB Thu. They asked specifically about embeddings, prompt logs, and debug snapshots. Can we assemble a one-page CSV + attestation?

anya_security: I can pull the CAIQ rows for data handling, logging, and key management. Two clarifying Qs: do they want cryptographic proof (e.g., KMS rotate record) or operational proof (purge-job logs + ticket)?

rob_privacy: For DSAR/deletion acceptance, customers usually accept purge-job logs + S3 delete markers + attestation signed by Legal. Cryptographic proof is nice but rarely required for POC. We'll include the controller/processor sentence.

viv_infra: Storage notes: embeddings -> rds-encrypted (eu), prompts(debug) -> ephemeral-blobstore (eu). Default retention values we can change per-POC. For this customer we can set embeddings=30d, prompts=7d. We can produce sample artifacts (sanitized):
```
- s3_delete_marker_example.txt
- purge_job_run_2026-02-18.log
- db_tombstone_row_example.json
```
I will attach sanitized examples to the walkthrough invite.

mike_sales: Perfect. Can you also scope who has access to each store? Procurement wants an "access" column.

anya_security: I'll produce mapping with CAIQ refs + access column. Access model: RBAC for S3/RDS, strict ACLs for encrypted-store, devops access is logged and audited.

rob_privacy: Draft DPA sentence for paste: "During the POC, Redwood will not use customer prompts, telemetry, or embeddings for model training or improvement without explicit written opt-in by the customer. Telemetry retention, export, and deletion will follow the POC onboarding configuration and the DSAR runbook provided."

ops-bot: DSAR ticket created: DSAR-2026-556. Owner: privacy-ops.

anya_security: CSV mapping (compact) - one-line-per-telemetry for procurement sheet: copy/paste friendly
```
telemetry,storage,region,encryption,access,retention_days,deletion_evidence,caiq_ref
embeddings,rds-encrypted,eu-west-1,KMS,svc-roles+acl,30,db-tombstone+purge-log,DP-3
prompts(debug only),ephemeral-blob,eu-west-1,KMS,limited-devops,7,blob-deleted+audit,AP-4
request_logs,s3-logs,eu-west-1,KMS,rbac+audit,21,s3-delete-marker+job-log,SC-8
metrics,tsdb,eu-west-1,disk-enc,svc-roles,90,retention-policy-log,CM-2
kv-snapshots(mem),ephemeral,eu-west-1,NA,devops-only,0 (ephemeral),snapshot-delete-note,aud-1
```

viv_infra: Note: for embeddings we can also provide KMS key rotation record as additional evidence on request.

anya_security: I'll attach CAIQ excerpts that reference the above CAIQ IDs and include a short note: "POC-specific controls (retention, region pinning, debug logging) are enforced by the POC onboarding config and will be reverted at POC close."

mike_sales: Legal wants the attestation line. Rob, can Legal sign a short attestation PDF saying "we deleted the POC telemetry as described and attach purge logs" after we run purge?

legal-bot: We can provide a signed attestation template. Please route attestation request to legal-ops with ticket DSAR-2026-556 and attach the purge artifacts. Typical turnaround 2 business days.

rob_privacy: I'll prepare the DSAR runbook bullets for the POC: 1) verify requester identity 2) collect scope (models, embeddings, logs) 3) generate export + redaction 4) run purge job(s) 5) generate deletion evidence (logs + markers) 6) legal attestation and close. SLA: acknowledge 48h, deliver export 20 days, deletion attested in 5 business days after confirmation.

mike_sales: Great. Can we pin the POC to eu-west-1 and enable VPC endpoints? Customer requested region lock.

viv_infra: Yes. We'll pin to eu-west-1, enforce VPC endpoints, and restrict admin console access to approved CIDR. Will reflect this in the dataflow diagram.

anya_security: I'll assemble everything (CSV, CAIQ excerpts, DSAR runbook, DPA sentence) and drop in this thread + attach to the calendar. Expect a draft in ~2 hours.

mike_sales: Thanks team. I'll message procurement with the CSV once you post it. :white_check_mark:

(edited)
